description: Show monitors, healthchecks, components or servers on a status page, in the section you name (created at the end if the page has none by that name) or the first one. Services already on the page stay where they are. A healthcheck shows its uptime bar (show_uptime) but never response times.

section.description: Section to add them to, by title. Default: the first section.

services.description: Monitors (mon_...) and components (comp_...): UUIDs from list_monitors or get_status_page. Healthchecks (hc_...): from list_healthchecks. Servers (agt_...): from get_status_page, or the end of the server's dashboard address (/servers/agt_...); no tool lists them. Paused monitors are refused, as in the dashboard.

show_response_times.description: Show the response time chart of each monitor. Default false. Never shown for a healthcheck, which has none.

show_uptime.description: Show the 90-day uptime bar of each service. Default true.

name: add_status_page_services
title: Add services to status page
